name: Ladder
summary: The sole exit lies across a full-height permanent wall.
proofSteps: The initial player is at (14, 0), east of column x=5. Every one of the 32 top-layer cells (5, y), 0<=y<=31, is an ordinary Wall, with Empty below.
The only Exit in either layer is (4, 0), west of that column. The level has no teleporters. Cardinal movement cannot leave or wrap around the 32 x 32 board.
Ordinary walls cannot be removed by the available actors or buttons. Toggle buttons only exchange the toggle-wall tiles. Therefore no legal play can transfer Chip to the west side and reach the exit.

experiments.result: Exact DAT metadata/layers decoded; initial production runtime loaded and rendered with repository sprites.

limitations: Proof concerns ordinary legal play; cheats/editor changes excluded.
